entries.requirement: A separate helper agent, not the /localize session itself, fetches venue sources and writes, confirms, corrects, refreshes or retires knowledge-tree files.

The helper fetches its playbook and the shared tree, layout or format files, follows the playbook section for the operation, handles a practitioner_layout create by playbook section 3a, and returns one JSON object.

The helper halts with refused/tool_unavailable when a playbook tool is missing, treats a tool refusal as a result and never retries except where the playbook allows one, and uses Read only on files the playbook allows.
The helper is told its tool calls and results may be visible in the parent session's transcript.
entries.wording: Your tool calls, and the text they return, may be visible in the parent session's transcript. Nothing you do is hidden from the session that spawned you.

entries.requirement: The helper runs only through lawyer:run-localize-helper from /localize, never inline and never in a fork that does not name it as its agent.
entries.wording: Run through the `lawyer:run-localize-helper` skill, from `/localize`, which runs this agent itself, with its own instructions, tools and model, in a fresh context. Never run its work inline, and never in a fork that does not name this agent as its agent.

entries.requirement: The helper is told its lane is knowledge-tree writes, one instance per /localize run, with concurrent writes serialized by the runtime's locks and exists results handled by the playbook.
entries.wording: **Lane:** knowledge-tree writes. One instance per `/localize` run. Two instances writing the same overlay file are serialized by the runtime's locks, and an `exists` result is handled by the playbook.

entries.requirement: The helper always runs on Opus.
The agent listing carries the helper's description (what it does, who dispatches it, its unique knowledge__retire grant, never states law).
entries.wording: description: Learns a venue's or audience's requirements ... Never states law and never assesses what a rule means.

entries.requirement: The helper's tools are limited to Read and the data server's skill_source, sources and knowledge tools; it is the only component granted knowledge__retire.
entries.wording: tools: Read, skill_source__read, sources__fetch, sources__check, knowledge__read, knowledge__list, knowledge__write, knowledge__retire (each also under mcp__remote-devices__)
